title: After surgery
intro: How to help your cat heal at home after an operation. After every surgery, your cat needs a cone so they cannot lick or pull at their stitches.
note: We are not vets, and these guides never replace your vet's advice. Always follow your vet's instructions after surgery. We share the practical side we learned caring for our own rescues: how to set up their space, keep wounds clean and help them heal at home.
